findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-501.110: The dish machine is observed still out of order during today’s inspection. PIC stated maintenance has started repairs and are waiting on parts. An additional follow-up will take place on 2/20/2024 to retest the dish machine. Inspector will contact the PIC at (217)525-3261 the morning of 2/20/2024 to inquire about the repairs. If at that time no repairs have been made, the re-inspection will be moved accordingly. Facility is utilizing their triple sink as a temporary alternative.
4-501.110: (A) Temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers using hot water may not be less than: 165F for stationary rack-single temperature, 150F for stationary rack-dual temperature machine, 160F single tank, conveyor-dual temperature, 150F multitank conveyor-multitemperature. (B) Temperature for wash solution using chemical SANITIZER may not be less than 120F.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-501.110: The dish machine was ran multiple times and tested with a temperature measuring disc and heat test strips. The dish machine was recorded at 145 degrees F for three straight cycles. The temperature at the plate surface must reach at least 160 degrees F for proper sanitizing to occur. A service order has been ordered for the machine. A follow-up has been issued for February 9, 2024 to retest the dish machine as being operational to standards. While the machine is down, facility is utilizing their triple sink as a temporary solution for the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Ensure the machine is tested daily or at a frequency necessary to maintain it in operational order. 
4-501.110: (A) Temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers using hot water may not be less than: 165F for stationary rack-single temperature, 150F for stationary rack-dual temperature machine, 160F single tank, conveyor-dual temperature, 150F multitank conveyor-multitemperature. (B) Temperature for wash solution using chemical SANITIZER may not be less than 120F.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The dish machine was observed to be leaking water during its cycle. It was observed the water was leaking from the seal of the corner piece where a gap is present with visible build-up. Ensure these gaps are sealed to prevent water from leaking out of the dish washer during the cycle. PIC has received email confirmation during the inspection that a work order has been placed.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The electrical wire of the standing hot holding unit is observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil residues. Ensure this surface is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain the free of dust/soil.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Thee is observed soil underneath the triple door cooler. This area needs to have attention given to it in order to clean the soils. Ensure regular cleaning is performed under the equipment to maintain the surfaces free of soil.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The sink with he sprayer next to the dish machine is observed to have a pipe coming through the metal. The gaps around the pipe need to be sealed with caulking or another substance that creates a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces. Ensure this repair is made to prevent accumulation of soil reside in the gaps.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: No test kit for quat sanitizer available to check the sanitizer concentration. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide and use test kit for sanitizer.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The fan blowing across the dish drying area has some dust accumulation. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. Properly clean fan and maintain clean so that it does not contaminate clean dishes.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: Cooling pasta with meat sauce placed in the cooler with no time on label.  Pasta was 98F. 750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F. Corner was popped to allow steam to escape and time was placed on label. Spaghetti was in cooler for 45min.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: Bucket of sanitizer at 100ppm of Quat. 750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses. Bucket was remade to be 200ppm of quat.  Utilize test strips to make sure that sanitizer is at proper concentration.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment: Observed cook to touch a cooked meat loaf patty with bare hands when trying to arrange paper on tray. Her hands had recently been washed. 750-280 Food handlers & consumers shall avoid direct hand contact with ready to eat foods.  When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.) The cook washed hands and put on single use gloves.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment: The dish machine is not sanitizing consistently. A dish tag placed through a cycle did not turn as required to indicate that the machine is functioning properly. 750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dish washing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  Properly sanitize all items. Check and maintain the dishwasher frequently. Dish machine may be used for wash and rinse but sanitize must be conducted in the three part sink with 200ppm of quat or sanitizer permitted by EPA as a food safe sanitizer.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
Observed the auto dish machine sanitizing temperature at 120F.
750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dish washing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  
Sanitize equipment at a temperature of at least 180F.  Corrected:  The booster was off.  After turning the booster on, the rinse temperature was 186F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following to be soiled: 1.can opener holder (dried food), 2.box fan (dust on guard).
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Clean the above listed items and maintain clean.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Did not observe the restroom door to be self-closing.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  
Provide a self-closing restroom door.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The caulking at the disposal sink was damaged and peeling away from the wall. Recaulk the disposal sink to the wall.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
REPEAT: The floor drain under the 3 compartment sink has mold build up. Clean the floor drain.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floors behind the cook line equipment and beneath the dish machine were soiled with debris.  Also, the floor drain beneath the three compartment sink had mold build up.  Clean the mentioned areas.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
